QUOTE: The Doxyfile no longer chooses the input set. Since gh#333 it supplies aliases and predefined macros only. An older Doxyfile-as-scope fallback was removed.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the Doxyfile no longer decides the input set, but it never explains why: that a repository shipping a Doxyfile would get only its documented subset while one with none gets its whole tree.
